Sprites in this folder are from Kenney asset packs (www.kenney.nl):
Tiny Dungeon (1.0), 1-Bit Pack, and Roguelike RPG Pack.

License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0)
http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Each sprite was cropped to its visible pixels and scaled 4x (nearest
neighbour). labels.json lists each file's category, split (tune/test),
source pack, and position in that pack.
